summary: ITER 34 — Withdrawals (Wallet + Promotion ZAR) + AdminUsersPage ambassador toggle + AmbassadorDashboardPage conversion-pill removal. Backend: 25/25 pytest PASS — eligibility gate (403 at score < 3500 with exact message containing '3500'), MIME validation (data:text/* rejected with 'PDF…' message; data:image/png + data:application/pdf accepted), 5 MB oversize rejected, Pydantic schema (source enum, amount_zar > 0, full_name min 2), wallet balance check + reservation debit, promotion balance check + reservation debit (each source isolated), GET /withdrawals/me shape (balances, eligibility, processing_window_hours='24-48'), account_number masked (•••...7890) in list while admin sees raw, proof endpoint returns full data url for owner, admin gating 403 on /admin/withdrawals for non-admin, full flow wallet→reject→refund (300→150 debit → 300 after reject), full flow promotion→approve→note→mark-paid (3 admin_notes, no refund on paid), state-machine invariant: mark-paid blocked unless approved (400), status_filter=all returns everything + search query matches, admin proof endpoint, in-app notification created for every admin on submit. Regression: /api/admin/promotions list, /api/promotions/active, /api/users/me/promotions, /api/promotions/me/login-summary all 200. PROMOTION AUTO-CREDIT: verified end-to-end — created 24x7 promo (eligible_actions=['post_create'], zar_per_point=0.10), POST /api/posts triggered award_points → _record_promotion_event → user.promotion_zar_balance incremented as expected. Frontend (live UI): ambassador-conversion-pill REMOVED from /ambassadors/me ✅, open-withdrawal-modal CTA present on /wallet ✅, admin-go-withdrawals button on /admin/dashboard navigates to /admin/withdrawals ✅, non-admin sees 'Admin only.' on /admin/withdrawals ✅. Modal interior (step1/step2/step3, source-wallet/promotion, amount, next-1, proof-input) verified via source inspection (data-testids match spec).

integration_issues.flow: Playwright clicking buttons on first daily visit
integration_issues.issue: PromotionsWelcomeModal (z-100 backdrop) intercepts pointer events until dismissed. Auto-suppression workaround: set localStorage.nc_promo_modal_last_shown=<today YYYY-MM-DD> BEFORE page.goto. Not a real user bug — affects automation only.

action_items: (Carry-over from iter32, STILL unfixed) server.py:8195 — `async for uid in db.promotion_events.distinct(...)` is a latent bug; Motor's distinct() returns coroutine→List, not async-iterable. Will silently swallow under broad except → no window-open notifications. Fix: `for uid in await db.promotion_events.distinct('user_id', {'promotion_id': promo['id']}):`

(Minor UX) AdminUsersPage row kebab button has no data-testid on the opener itself — only the dropdown items (menu-ambassador-{userId}) carry testids. Consider adding `data-testid={`user-menu-toggle-${u.id}`}` to the MoreVertical button so automation can open the menu deterministically.

(Console warning observed) AdminWithdrawalsPage logs `An error occurred in the <Row> component. Consider adding an error boundary to your tree…` on first render — appears to be a non-fatal React dev warning (page still renders). Recommend wrapping Row in an ErrorBoundary or guarding `w.account_number?.slice(-4)` etc against undefined fields on legacy rows.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py L8456 _mask_account: when `num` has 5+ chars but contains spaces, count uses pre-strip length but the • count uses stripped length — fine but inconsistent; consider always working on stripped.

server.py L8520-8531 admin notifications: `async for u in db.users.find({role:{$in:[admin,moderator]}}…)` correctly fans out, but if there are zero admins (rare seed), the if-guard prevents empty insert_many — good. Consider also fanning out a Pub/Sub event for any future email/push pipeline.

server.py L8459-8491 create_withdrawal: balance debit + insert is NOT atomic (no transaction); if the insert_one fails after the $inc, funds remain debited. For ITER34 acceptable since failure modes are minimal, but flag for hardening: wrap in a Motor session.with_transaction or compensate-on-error.

WithdrawalRequestModal.js L69 canAdvance1 also gates on `eligibility?.eligible` — good. But while eligibility is still loading (null), the button is disabled silently with no spinner — consider showing `Loading eligibility…` to avoid users thinking the button is broken.

AdminWithdrawalsPage.js L84 Row maps without runtime field guards — if a legacy doc lacks `account_number_masked` or `created_at`, the Row will throw (matches the dev-mode console warning seen during testing). Add defensive `?.` accessors or ErrorBoundary.

WithdrawalRequestModal.js L94 backdrop `onClick={onClose}` — note this closes the modal even mid-flow if user accidentally taps outside the dialog. Consider adding a confirm prompt when KYC data is partially entered.
